items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1962-02-06
items.q: Who taught you to play trumpet, Peter? ... Well the old man Brookhoven ... So I went to him and in a couple of lessons I had the horn down

ctx.x: Who taught you to play trumpet, Peter?

Well the old man Brookhoven, he had a band, he was an old German, you know. And the Brookhoven band, Brass Band, you know. He had a couple of boys play trumpet and one played in the theater, you know. Leo I think his name was, but his daddy, well you see I was a musician already because I was playing violin, but all I wanted to learn was the horn. See I knew the music and everything, see. So I went to him and in a couple of lessons I had the horn down, you see, that was all the lesson. I just wanted to learn the…
Who taught you to play trombone? Hmm? Who taught you to play trombone? Trombone? Myself.
